name: Wheat flour, white (~76% extraction, all-purpose)
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 119 g, protein 103 g, fat 10 g, ash 5 g, carbohydrate by difference 763 g, typical of white all-purpose wheat flour milled to roughly 76% extraction (USDA FoodData Current pattern for enriched all-purpose flour).
notes: Same conversion method as wheat-grain. White flour's lower ash and mineral content relative to the whole grain reflects the bran and germ being milled away — see wheat-bran and wheat-germ, which carry the minerals this file lacks. Compare compositionMass(getComposition('wheat-flour-white', m)) + compositionMass(bran) + compositionMass(germ) is NOT expected to equal wheat-grain's per-kg figures exactly, because milling yields are not 100% flour+bran+germ (some loss to milling streams); each file stands on its own sourced composition, closed independently by Ash.
